sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Ground Zero is a location in Escape from Tarkov. It is the tenth map that was added to the game.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: The business center of Tarkov. This is where TerraGroup was headquartered. This is where it all began. The area has yet again become a hot zone since the early days of the conflict.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
Matchmaking on this location is divided into beginners (Level <21) and experienced players (Level 21+). For groups, matchmaking is based on the highest level player in the group.

In experienced matchmaking there are the following differences:
- Chance to find rare loot
- Increased Scavs difficulty
- Cultists can appear

sections.heading: Features
sections.text:
- Stationary weapons in the form of AGS-30 30x29mm automatic grenade launchers and NSV Utyos 12.7x108 heavy machine guns.
- Be aware of Minefields, Claymores and Border Snipers!

sections.heading: Bosses
sections.text: Seasonal change: Black Division can occasionally roam through the level 21+ version of the location. They do not have a fixed spawn location and have to be expected everywhere.
